rows.title: A tax date with its source
rows.defect: the note drops where the date came from
rows.test: extended 2025 returns due Thursday, October 15, 2026, 3 days, IRS calendar checked Oct 12, 2026

rows.title: Weekends move a tax date
rows.defect: a weekend never moves the date
rows.test: Saturday Oct 24 is due Monday Oct 26, and the note says why

rows.title: Legal holidays move it again
rows.defect: holidays are ignored after the weekend
rows.test: Jan 15, 2028 is due Tuesday Jan 18 (MLK Day); Apr 15, 2028 is due Apr 18 (Emancipation Day)

rows.title: Only official sources on file
rows.defect: an http link from anywhere is accepted as a source
rows.test: a blog link is refused; every published date matches the rule

rows.title: The person's day
rows.defect: today is read in UTC
rows.test: 11:30 p.m. Oct 12 in New York: 3 days left, the 14-day note

rows.title: Old dates are said as possibly changed
rows.defect: dates on file never go stale
rows.test: checked Sep 1, 2025: may have changed, check irs.gov; enrollment after 90 days

rows.title: Estimated tax only for people who pay it
rows.defect: every audience's dates are said to everyone
rows.test: no estimated-tax note on Jan 1 without the fact

rows.title: 14 days and 2 days before
rows.defect: only the 14-day note is ever said
rows.test: Dec 5 is the 2-day note for Dec 7

rows.title: Said once
rows.defect: the log is not checked
rows.test: a logged key is not said again

rows.title: Quiet hours hold it
rows.defect: deadline notes go out in quiet hours
rows.test: 10 p.m. Dec 5: held as quiet_hours

rows.title: Alerts off silences public dates only
rows.defect: public dates go out with alerts off
rows.test: Apr 1 with alerts off: the return date held; the FSA date still said

rows.title: The daily budget
rows.defect: a public note never counts against the budget
rows.test: a public 14-day note uses the budget; within 2 days it is exempt

rows.title: The FSA grace period wins
rows.defect: the plan-year end is used even with a grace period
rows.test: plan year Dec 31, grace to Mar 15: the date is Mar 15

rows.title: Work open enrollment from the person's dates
rows.defect: the person's work dates are never read
rows.test: Nov 2 to Nov 13: closes Friday, Nov 13, 2 days

rows.title: What could not be confirmed is said
rows.defect: the unconfirmed-date note is dropped
rows.test: the 2027 HealthCare.gov close date note

rows.title: Other taxes and advice go on
rows.defect: the advice and other-tax filter is dropped
rows.test: "when are property taxes due" is not a federal date

rows.title: Sources with their checked date
rows.defect: the sources line is dropped
rows.test: Sources, checked Oct 12, 2026: ...

rows.title: Past the file, it says so
rows.defect: past dates are listed as if ahead
rows.test: Feb 1, 2028: the tax dates run through Jan 18, 2028

rows.title: A fact can be taken back
rows.defect: the fact is kept after forget
rows.test: forget my medicare deadline removes it

rows.title: The extension's tax year
rows.defect: this year's return is assumed
rows.test: Oct 12, 2026: the 2025 return

rows.title: An extension covers its own year only
rows.defect: any extension fact applies to every extended date
rows.test: a 2025 extension says nothing about Oct 15, 2027

rows.title: Only real dates
rows.defect: an impossible date is stored
rows.test: February 30 asks again
